card.name: Last digit of a percentage
card.fires_on: The final digit of a number right before a percent sign, in adverse-reaction rates such as '44% of patients' or 'compared to 18% of patients'.

modes.label: Digit before % in trial rates
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit or decimal percentage that is about to be followed by % and 'of patients'.
modes.example: Infections occurred in 71% of LEMTRADA-treated patients compared to 5<<3>>% of patients treated with interferon beta

modes.label: Digit in drug-versus-placebo comparison
modes.description: The digit of the second percentage in a comparison of treatment and placebo groups.
modes.example: subjects treated with VELSIPITY was 24.9% compared to 22.<<2>>% in subjects who received placebo.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of closing-bracket-plus-percent endings like '%)' and '%).', so the percent sign is more likely to come on its own.
card.plain: It marks the last digit of a percentage in a side-effect rate, just before the percent sign.
